notes:
Summary: Blackfjord is a midsize support-platform vendor building a conversational support agent + ticket deflection product. Primary success metrics: high deflection rate, top-5 answer precision, and very tight latency SLOs for interactive agent flows.

Key requirements (from platform call):
- Indexing scale: target pilot 5M tickets, plan to scale to 20M+ (histor logs + KB + community forum).
- Retrieval latency: target <100ms median, 90th <250ms for retrieval+rerank combined in agent hot path.
- Reranking: must boost top-5 precision by >=12% vs baseline ANN+BM25; want a configurable rerank budget (per-query tradeoff).
- Cost: target cost-per-query (incl. embedding retrieval + rerank) ~<$0.002 at scale; will consider quantized models or dedicated pools.
- Security: SSO/SAML, SOC2, KMS integration, EU data residency and audit logs.
- Deployment: prefer VPC-dedicated for production; open to hosted API for initial rollouts.

POC notes (tone: shorthand):
- POC dataset: 5M tickets (400GB raw), embeddings footprint ~70GB (float16 quantizing test planned).
- Retrieval engine tested: Faiss HNSW + prefix caching; initial candidate size k=100.
- Reranker: tuned small cross-encoder fine-tuned on labeled support QA set; improved MAP@5 and P@1, but added latency. Need to test model distillation / cascaded rerank to reclaim time.
- Observability ask: token-level cost breakdown, per-route latency, per-query rerank time.
- Failure mode: occasional stale KB fragments -> recall tuning + freshness window needed.

Quotes: "If top-5 isn’t reliable, CS will keep human-in-loop and deflection stays low." - Hannah Voss (Head of Platform).

Decision criteria:
- Demonstrate 90th pctile end-to-end <250ms at 5M index with realistic concurrency (50 qps).
- Show cost path to <$0.002/query at 20M index using batching + optimized kernels.
- Provide enterprise contract: SLA, SOC2 artifacts, EU residency option.
